model.name: Phone index as ln symlinks
model.description: Each phone number is normalized to +<CountryCode><digits> (no spaces, dashes, or parentheses) and registered as an ln symlink in the index pointing to the owning profile scenario unit, making the phone an alternate UUID for that profile.
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "standardized format +CountryCode digits only (e.g. +4915253844085, no spaces/dashes/parens). Each phone becomes an ln symlink in index pointing to profile scenario unit. Phone numbers are alternate UUIDs."
model.implRef: ior:file:src/ts/scenario/PhoneIndex.ts: normalizePhone L18-23, isValidPhoneKey L26-28, registerSymlink L38-44 [impl:uuid:4242f9be-58d9-4417-8480-000000210003], resolveToProfile L80-90

acceptanceCriteria.text: A phone key is normalized to +<digits> (normalizePhone strips all non-digits); isValidPhoneKey requires /^\+\d{6,15}$/ before the key may become a path.
An invalid/empty key is rejected: registerSymlink returns null and writes no symlink.

registerSymlink(profileUuid, rawPhone) creates alt/phone/<key>.scenario.json as a relative symlink pointing to the PROFILE's canonical scenario file (the symlink target is the PROFILE, not the Phone unit).

The link is declared on the Profile's unitLinks[] (via index.addLink -> ensureSymlinkDisk), so it self-writes on put() and self-removes when the profile is removed — one source of truth (the unit JSON).
registerSymlink returns null if the profile does not exist (no dangling symlink).
resolveToProfile(rawPhone) normalizes the input, follows alt/phone/<key>.scenario.json, and returns the owning profile uuid — i.e. the phone number is an ALTERNATE UUID for the profile.
resolveToProfile returns null on an invalid key or a missing symlink (new identity).

testScenarios.name: key normalize+validate
testScenarios.then: '+49 1525 384-4085' -> '+4915253844085' valid; '123' invalid (registerSymlink returns null, no link)

testScenarios.name: symlink points to profile, declared on unitLinks
testScenarios.then: alt/phone/+4915253844085.scenario.json resolves to P's canonical file AND the linkPath is in P.unitLinks[]

testScenarios.name: missing profile -> null
testScenarios.then: it returns null and writes no symlink

testScenarios.name: resolve phone -> profile (alt UUID)
testScenarios.given: a registered alt/phone symlink for P
testScenarios.then: returns P; an unregistered or invalid number returns null

testScenarios.name: self-removes on profile remove
testScenarios.given: a profile P with a phone symlink
testScenarios.when: P is removed from the index
